D/ [CONST]ANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ VIR[TVS EXERCIT]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Trier mint Virtus Exercit issue of 320-321, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped left. Obverse inscription: [CONST]ANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Trophy with two captives seated below it; trophy inscribed [VOT] / XX; S F in field. Reverse inscription: VIR[TVS EXERCIT]. In exergue: STR. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.1mm, Weight: 2.49gms, die axis: 6
